boundary: NISAR shows a sharp E-W discontinuity at about 10.51–10.52°N across the lower Yaracuy valley and coastal plain, from about 68.45°W east to Morón (68.20°W). North of it (Boca de Aroa/Tucacas side) LOS is +10 to +28 cm; south of it (Urama/Morón side) it is −15 to −27 cm. The jump is up to ~30 cm over 1.5–2 km, with a thin low-coherence seam. West of 68.5°W it fades into a smooth gradient past Farriar, and San Felipe itself (68.74°W) shows only ~3 cm. NOTE: the existing site blurb places the trace 'west of San Felipe'; the data put it ~45 km ENE of San Felipe, north of Urama–Morón. GEER mapped no field-verified surface rupture in this frame (their only verified rupture is at Maiquetía, outside it).

items.title: Las Colinas de Morón: 16 houses fell, two women killed, 250 families sleeping outside
items.place: Barrio Las Colinas de Morón (old barrio Juro), Morón, Carabobo
items.what_it_shows: El Carabobeño / Diario de Los Andes: at least 16 homes collapsed, killing Elizabeth Margarita Gómez Argüello (49) and Paula Margarita Arias López (61). Seven were injured, more than 50 houses had structural damage, and 250 families had not returned five days later because aftershocks kept opening new cracks.
items.credit: Dayrí Blanco / El Carabobeño (photos courtesy of residents)
items.notes: Nominatim places 'Las Colinas' (Colinas de Pequiven, Morón) at this point. The article names the barrio, not streets, so the location is good to about 300–500 m. en.wikipedia also gives '>25 homes destroyed in the Morón and Urama parishes'.

items.title: La Mar Suites, Tucacas: beachfront block collapsed, 12 dead
items.place: La Mar Suites residential complex and hotel, Tucacas, Falcón
items.what_it_shows: El Nacional (citing El Carabobeño): the building, a few metres from the beach, collapsed; 12 bodies were recovered by 28 June, two people were rescued alive and 33 injured. en.wikipedia confirms 12 dead and 33 injured at La Mar Suites.
items.notes: The complex was not found in OSM, so this is the Tucacas town node; the building is 'a few metres from the beach'. The location is good to only about 1–2 km. It sits close to the north edge of the frame (v≈0.04).

items.title: Boca de Aroa: sand and water boiled up through cracks during the shaking
items.place: Boca de Aroa, Silva municipality, Falcón
items.what_it_shows: GEER ch. 9: StEER-geolocated video shows sand ejecta and settled light structures in this low-lying settlement on loose sand. A resident describes water and sediment rising through cracks during the shaking. en.wikipedia: 87 homes damaged and 252 residents affected in Boca de Aroa parish.
items.credit: GEER-087 report (Cabas, Sancio et al.), citing StEER (2026) DesignSafe PRJ-6380
items.notes: The point is the OSM town node. The exact StEER media coordinates are in DesignSafe PRJ-6380 and were not retrieved. GEER flags this site as not yet visited by an engineering team.

items.title: Pueblo Farriar: a 380 m crack opened along the river bank
items.place: Pueblo Farriar (El Farriar), Veroes municipality, Yaracuy
items.what_it_shows: GEER Table 9-2 / Fig. 9-17 / Fig. 11-16: a river-parallel fissure about 380 m long, at most 3 m from the channel, photographed 12 July 2026 by R. Mata, E. Núñez et al. GEER also reports large, deep ground cracks between Agua Negra and Palmarejo (10.49–10.50°N, 68.51–68.53°W; LOS +5 to +6 cm, also smooth).
items.credit: Ramón Mata, Eduardo Núñez et al., in GEER-087 (doi:10.18118/G6S95Q), Figs. 9-17 and 11-16
items.notes: Coordinates are given in the GEER report (marker coordinates). GEER says the site is ~4 km from the 'M7.5 epicenter'; read that as the M7.2 San Felipe event, since the M7.5 was offshore near Catia La Mar.

items.title: San Felipe: 13 homes heavily damaged, yet NISAR barely moved
items.what_it_shows: en.wikipedia: 'In Yaracuy state... 13 homes were heavily damaged in San Felipe, two buildings under construction collapsed in Cocorote, and cracks appeared in one home in Independencia.' Light damage compared with Morón and Tucacas on either side of the trace.
items.notes: Marked 'unaffected' only in relative terms; there was some damage. The point is the OSM city node, good to about 1 km. Cocorote (10.3195,-68.7831) gives +1.9 cm and is similarly quiet.
